verdict.rationale: Fin explicitly documents multi-channel support spanning live chat/messenger (in-app), email, Slack, WhatsApp, SMS, and voice, with dedicated channel pages for each (docs-9, docs-50, docs-51, docs-65, docs-48). Missing for 10: explicit named coverage of broader 'social' channels like Instagram/Facebook/X/Twitter — only 'and more' is implied, not documented by name, so the specific 'social' claim in the story is only partially evidenced.
